_meta.note: This module's own texts. The host reads this file from locales/en.json beside the bundle's entry and merges it under the module's namespace. Copy it to <tag>.json to translate; a key you leave out falls back to the line here.
gentle-first-layer.what: While the first layer prints, speed {speed} % and the bed {bed} °C warmer. Then the bed goes back and the speed climbs back to 100 % over {layers} layers. Works with any slicer.
gentle-first-layer.speed_low: Slower than the printer's screen allows (it stops at {menu} %). It works, but is rarely needed.
gentle-first-layer.phase.idle: Not printing. It starts on its own with the next print.
gentle-first-layer.phase.waiting: The print is starting. It steps in once the printer heats up and goes down to the first layer.
gentle-first-layer.phase.done: First layer done, the speed and the bed are back where they were.
gentle-first-layer.phase.skipped: This print was already past its first layer when it was switched on. It helps the next one.
gentle-first-layer.taken.speed: You changed the speed yourself, so it leaves the speed alone for the rest of this print.
gentle-first-layer.taken.bed: You changed the bed temperature yourself, so it leaves the bed alone for the rest of this print.
gentle-first-layer.taken.both: You changed the speed and the bed yourself, so it leaves both alone for the rest of this print.
gentle-first-layer.note.unsupported: This printer doesn't take speed and bed temperature changes from Connect.
gentle-first-layer.note.denied: It isn't allowed to change this printer's speed and bed. Allow it again, or ask an administrator.
gentle-first-layer.error.load: The settings couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
gentle-first-layer.error.save: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
gentle-first-layer.error.grant: You can't allow it to change this printer's speed and bed. Ask an administrator to switch it on.
